name: Fish It!
creator: Fish Atelier
redeem: Launch Fish It! on Roblox and fish until you reach level 10, because the code box stays locked before that.
Tap the Shop button, the shopping cart icon on your screen, to open the store.
Scroll all the way to the bottom of the shop window to find the ENTER CODE! box.
Type or paste a code exactly as written and press the green Redeem button.
Open your backpack to find the potion or cosmetic you just got.
notes:
Fish It! is a fishing game from Fish Atelier, inspired by Fisch and Fishing Simulator. You click to charge up your cast, then click as fast as you can to reel in the fish. Every catch can roll a different size and mutation, so there are over a million versions to collect. You sell fish for coins, buy better rods and bait, and sail to new islands, like the limited Arcadia island from the latest update.

Most Fish It! codes give Luck II or Mutation II potions, plus the odd cosmetic like a halo or lantern. Luck II potions are the best pick when you are hunting a secret fish, so drink them before a long fishing session. New codes tend to show up with big updates, like goals and holidays, and every code needs you to be at least level 10.

faq.q: Why won't Fish It! let me type in a code?
faq.a: The code box only unlocks once you reach level 10. Keep fishing at the starting island for a bit and it will open up.

faq.q: Should I use a Luck II or a Mutation II potion first?
faq.a: Use Luck II when you want rarer fish, such as secret catches at a new island. Use Mutation II when you are fishing somewhere you already know well, since mutated fish sell for more coins.

faq.q: Did the Arcadia update come with a new code?
faq.a: No new code was reported with the Arcadia island. The newest code going around is ELEMENTAL26, which gives two Mutation II potions.

tips: Sell common fish and put the coins into a better rod. A stronger rod makes each fishing session pay off more.
Buy better bait before heading to a new island, so your early catches there are not wasted on weak bait.
Visit limited islands like Arcadia while they last. The game says its fish and gacha are limited time, so they may not stay forever.
Check the battlepass rewards often. They give extra prizes as you play, so make sure you claim them.
useRewards: The active codes give 6 Mutation II Potions, 2 Luck II Potions and two cosmetics, a lantern and a halo. Potions run out over time, so use them in one long fishing session instead of drinking them a few minutes at a time. The lantern and halo only change your look. Remember the code box needs level 10, so keep fishing until you get there.
codeChannels: The Fish Atelier Roblox group and the official Fish It! Discord server
requirement: You must be level 10 to redeem codes.
